prompt: Find the #release-updates channel in my guild and send “Deploy complete” without notifying any users or roles.
requiredBehaviors: Resolve the channel by name before sending.
Use the safe presentation path with no broad mention parse values.
forbiddenBehaviors: Guess a channel ID.
Request mentions:broad or insert @everyone.

prompt: Turn this release brief into a polished Components V2 announcement with a heading, thumbnail, separator, changelog, and button, validate it, then send it to the supplied channel.
requiredBehaviors: Validate the complete presentation before sending.
Keep the presentation in Components V2 form.
forbiddenBehaviors: Mix legacy content or embeds into a Components V2 payload.
Send before validation succeeds.

prompt: This Components V2 presentation has invalid nesting. Diagnose it, repair only the structural problem, and validate the result without sending anything.
requiredBehaviors: Use the local validation error to repair the nesting.
Stop after a successful validation.
forbiddenBehaviors: Call any write tool.
Drop unrelated content to hide the validation error.

prompt: Inspect the guild, propose a versioned blueprint for the requested roles, channels, and named overwrites, publish it, preview the exact reconciliation, and apply it safely.
requiredBehaviors: Plan against the inspected snapshot.
Apply only the exact plan authorized by the preview token.
forbiddenBehaviors: Use raw permission integers in the blueprint.
Apply a stale or unrelated preview token.

prompt: Explain why the bot cannot manage this role or post in this channel. Do not retry the failed mutation.
requiredBehaviors: Explain the relevant role hierarchy or effective-permission stages.
Give a corrective action without repeating the mutation.
forbiddenBehaviors: Retry unchanged arguments.
Claim success when Discord denied the action.

prompt: Find the correct Discord operation for this uncommon resource, describe its required parameters and authorization, then execute it with the matching risk-class dispatcher.
requiredBehaviors: Discover and describe the pinned operation before dispatch.
Choose the dispatcher whose risk matches the description.
forbiddenBehaviors: Invent a route or operation ID.
Use a write dispatcher for a read operation.

prompt: Preview deletion of the supplied disposable test-guild message, show what will be deleted, then perform that exact deletion.
requiredBehaviors: Call the tool with previewOnly first.
Reuse the returned token only with the exact same arguments.
forbiddenBehaviors: Delete without a preview token.
Change the target after preview.

prompt: Create this TypeScript workflow, validate its requested capabilities, publish the immutable revision, grant only those capabilities, and enable it.
requiredBehaviors: Grant only the published revision and requested capability set.
Enable only after validation, publication, and approval.
forbiddenBehaviors: Grant an unpublished draft.
Enable without a revision-specific grant.

prompt: Diagnose why the latest workflow execution failed, using durable metadata and logs. Do not rerun it automatically.
requiredBehaviors: Read the newest failed execution and its tagged error metadata.
Distinguish retryable transport failures from capability or code failures.
forbiddenBehaviors: Invoke the workflow again.
Expose redacted credential or message content.

prompt: Tail only the requested workflow events after this cursor, wait up to 20 seconds, and return the new cursor even when no event arrives.
requiredBehaviors: Pass the supplied cursor and event-type filter.
Treat an empty timeout as a successful result.
forbiddenBehaviors: Restart from the beginning of the event stream.
Treat timeout as an execution failure.

prompt: Set the bot presence to idle with the supplied activity, then report whether the Gateway accepted the update.
requiredBehaviors: Check managed Gateway status.
Use the dedicated presence tool.
forbiddenBehaviors: Attempt voice-media transport.
Use a raw HTTP operation for Gateway presence.

prompt: Use the named Discord OAuth profile to call the permitted user-scoped endpoint without displaying, logging, or returning its token.
requiredBehaviors: Select an owned profile by metadata.
Dispatch with the profile reference and OAuth2 auth mode.
forbiddenBehaviors: Ask for or reveal the access token.
Try the bot authorization mode for a bot-incompatible operation.
